The task requires each filter to be a single argument of the form `COLUMN=VALUE` (first `=` splits column from value), e.g. `--where customer=Acme`. The intended invocation cannot succeed as written.

But the argument parsing defect alone means the script does not accomplish the required behavior, so it is not functionally correct.
